rules: Exactly one queen per row, column, and color region.
Queens cannot touch, including diagonally adjacent cells.
Long diagonals are allowed; this is regional Queens, not chess N-Queens.
Exactly one full solution exists. Coordinates are 1-based.
state.coordinates: Rows top to bottom; columns left to right; both start at 1.
state.instruction: Keep placed queens fixed. Select a next decision consistent with the unique complete solution. No backtracking or solution feedback is supplied.

cell.instructions: Which cell in region A contains its queen in the unique full solution? Keep all placed queens fixed and consider all rows, columns, regions, and non-touch rules. Select a cell; do not merely prefer a locally legal cell if it makes completion impossible.
